table.name: TLGNR_COND_SAP_TYPE_BS
table.description: All Pricing condition types/tables from SAP. They are prioritized for correct evaluation within the same group of condition types distinguished by Logon. The Logon type decides if a condition is Material Price Condition (MP) and stored in tlgns_sap_mat_cond, or a Transport Cost Condition (TC, TRv, TRf) and stored in tlgns_sap_transport_cond.

column.name: COND_SAP_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Examples mat_cond: ZPR6/A584, ZP20/A638. Examples transport_cond: ZTE2/A526, ZT2B/A811.

column.name: COND_LOGON_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_cond_logon_type_cd. Defines as what type a condition type+table from SAP is treated in Logon. MP=Material Price, TC=Transport Cost, TRf=Transport Rate fix, TRv=Transport Rate var.

column.name: EVALUATION_PRIORITY
column.description: Priority to evaluate conditions of different SAP types. Rule: lowest number per logon type wins. All conditions in tlgns_sap_transport_cond or tlgns_sap_mat_cond which fullfill the filter criteria (material, shippingpoint, shipto, etc) are grouped by cond_logon_type. For each cond_logon_type which is required for a certain business case, the condition with the lowest evaluation_priority wins and is used. Per Logon type there must not be two SAP types with the same priority.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
